messages:
sam_infra: heads up — after the late-night keystore rollout we started seeing GPU node joins slow in eu-west-1 (~09:12 UTC). looks related to the new audit sampling config (earlybird) hitting the natgw/conntrack limits.
anya_sec: ugh, saw alerts. can you paste the error?
sam_infra: logs showing keystore 504s and repeated TLS handshakes. snippet: ```keystore: upstream read timeout from hsm-proxy; conntrack_rejected=1789```
lucas_sre: also seeing spike in kube join latency and kubelet backoff events. warm-pool depletion started ~09:20.
devops_bot: Deploy 2026-09-10T09:05:00Z completed: keystore/earlybird-config v2.1
nora_product: noticed user-facing latency on embeddings API around that time, small % errors but customers pinged.
anya_sec: the earlybird sampler set the audit qps to 1000 globally, right? we usually cap per-subnet.
sam_infra: yep, we flipped global to 1000 to reduce missed events, but natgw+conntrack on smaller AZs couldn't handle the spike — NAT conntrack hit and dropped new flows (GPU nodes couldn't complete keystore handshake).
lucas_sre: quick mitigation: reduce audit qps to 200 and enable per-subnet throttling. i'll patch now.
anya_sec: please also rotate the KMS signers temporarily? if keystore retries are spamming KMS it inflates costs and audit churn.
sam_infra: agreed. scheduling quick rollback for config + add per-subnet throttle. doing rollback in 2 mins.
devops_bot: Rollback job queued: earlybird-config v2.0 -> v2.1 rollback started by lucas_sre
lucas_sre: rolled back audit qps to 200, added per-subnet limits. monitoring conntrack and warm-pool.
sam_infra: warm-pool started replenishing at 09:42. join rate back to normal by 09:55.
anya_sec: cost note: audit log export volume spiked — preliminary estimate ~+$3.8k/day if left. we should alert finance and put a cap guard.
nora_product: can we throttle exports rather than sampling? customers depend on some audit fidelity.
anya_sec: propose: keep high fidelity for control-plane namespaces, throttle user-traffic audit exports, and add autoscaler hook so warm-pool resizes when conntrack approaches 80%.
lucas_sre: filing follow-up runbook items: (1) deploy per-subnet sampler by default, (2) add conntrack metric to warm-pool autoscaler, (3) add cost guard for audit export volumes.
sam_infra: +1. i'll create the PR for sampler limits and add a quick dashboard for conntrack+keystore latencies.
anya_sec: i'll draft an incident note for compliance: why keystore keys were retried and what we changed. include exact timestamps.
ora_product: ping me once we have the customer impact numbers; i'll coordinate comms.
devops_bot: Incident #INC-20260910-11 created (keystore-audit-surge-eu-west). assignees: sam_infra, lucas_sre, anya_sec
sam_infra: thanks — assigning the PR and runbook updates to the incident. will follow up in the incident channel with timelines. :thumbsup:
